name: Uyghurs (Kökbayraq)
description: A light blue field charged with a white crescent and five-pointed star, offset toward the hoist.
history: The Kökbayraq ('blue flag') was the flag of the First East Turkestan Republic (1933–1934) and is used today as the ethnic flag of the Uyghurs of Xinjiang and the diaspora; its design mirrors the flag of Turkey in Turkic blue.
